'This list defines data which is added to animationsetdatasinglefile.txt in order to enable pre-caching for custom animations
'FNIS will search for appearances of <reference path crc>/<reference file crc> in the asdsf, and add appropriate entries
'into the same block for each of the listed custom files. The entries are all defined in crc32 encoding 
'
'Each block in this list has the following structure. The optional <appearance1/2> parameters are only necessary, if the inclusion
'of the custom files is only needed for nth appearance of the reference file (usually one for defaultfemale and defaultmale each) 
'
'<Modname>
'<reference path crc>
'<reference file crc>[/<appearance1>,<appearance2>]
'<custom path crc>
'<no of custom animations to be added to the reference>
'  <custom file crc 1>
'  .......
'  <custom file crc n>
'
'
